papers.title: Euler–Maclaurin 公式与渐进估计
papers.meta: Term paper · Mathematical Analysis II · School of Mathematics, Shandong University · 72 pages
papers.summary: My first attempt at writing mathematics as a paper rather than as homework. It builds the Euler–Maclaurin summation formula from power sums and Bernoulli numbers, reads it through Riemann–Stieltjes integration, and then puts it to work: Stirling's formula, asymptotic expansions, Richardson extrapolation and Romberg integration, and the singular Euler–Maclaurin expansion for lattice sums.
papers.note: Reading view only — please do not redistribute. Ask me if you would like a copy.
